title: Primes of the fibre ring are the primes over p
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], $C=B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ and $j:B\to C$, $b\mapsto b\otimes1$. For a prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$ let $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=B_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak qB_{\mathfrak q}$, let $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$, $\lambda\mapsto\bar\lambda$, be the field homomorphism induced by $\varphi$ (the map on residue fields of the local homomorphism $A_{\mathfrak p}\to B_{\mathfrak q}$, $a/s\mapsto\varphi(a)/\varphi(s)$), and let $\psi_{\mathfrak q}:C\to\kappa(\mathfrak q)$ be the ring homomorphism with $\psi_{\mathfrak q}(b\otimes\lambda)=\bar b\,\bar\lambda$, $\bar b$ the image of $b$ in $\kappa(\mathfrak q)$. Then $\mathfrak Q\mapsto j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)$ is a bijection from the set of prime ideals of $C$ onto the set of prime ideals $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)=\mathfrak p$; its inverse is $\mathfrak q\mapsto\ker\psi_{\mathfrak q}$; and for primes $\mathfrak Q,\mathfrak Q'$ of $C$ one has $\mathfrak Q\subseteq\mathfrak Q'$ if and only if $j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q)\subseteq j^{-1}(\mathfrak Q')$.

source.place: Remark Tag 00E6 (remark-fundamental-diagram, line 3422): Spec of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\otimes_RS=S_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pS_{\mathfrak p}$ maps homeomorphically onto the fibre over $\mathfrak p$, by Lemma Tag 00E3 (lemma-spec-localization, line 3163) and Lemma Tag 00E5 (lemma-spec-closed, line 3227); the description of the inverse by $\ker\psi_{\mathfrak q}$ is the Mathlib form (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: `PrimeSpectrum.preimageOrderIsoFiber A B ⟨p, _⟩ : comap (algebraMap A B) ⁻¹' {p} ≃o PrimeSpectrum (p.Fiber B)` (line 182, `p.Fiber B = κ(p) ⊗[A] B`, line 66) is an order isomorphism (so it preserves and reflects inclusions) whose toEquiv is `preimageEquivFiber` (line 155): the inverse sends Q to Q.comap includeRight (`preimageEquivFiber_symm_apply_coe`, the simps lemma of line 154), and the forward map sends q to the kernel of `Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p q (Algebra.ofId A B) _) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B κ(q)) _`, λ ⊗ b ↦ λ̄ b̄ (`preimageEquivFiber_apply_asIdeal`). Transport along the ring isomorphism `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A B κ(p) : B ⊗[A] κ(p) ≃ κ(p) ⊗[A] B` (b ⊗ λ ↦ λ ⊗ b): it carries j to includeRight and ψ_q to that lift, so prime ideals, kernels and inclusions correspond.
